purpose: Review a finite issuer real-estate land-bank, project approval and construction, presale and contracted-sales, collection, completion and delivery lifecycle domain before opening source rows, project disclosures, filing values, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.operating_milestone_boundary: Campaign167 freezes general approvals, launch and operating milestones. A project milestone does not by itself preserve parcel and project identity, saleable inventory, presale obligations, cancellations, collections, delivery batches or complete failed and delayed project histories.
repository_evidence.operating_kpi_boundary: Campaign168 freezes generic operating scale, adoption and utilization KPIs. Contracted sales or delivered area can be KPI fields, but the project, unit, cancellation, consolidation, collection and obligation chains are distinct and cannot be inferred from aggregate scale alone.
repository_evidence.pricing_boundary: Campaign169 freezes commercial price and sales terms. Average selling price does not establish land rights, project stage, permitted inventory, contracted sales validity, cancellation, collection, completion or delivery fulfillment.
repository_evidence.owned_asset_capex_boundary: Campaign178 freezes productive assets and capital expenditure. Development inventory and land parcels are held for project development or sale rather than ordinary productive capacity, and require project, land-right, zoning, presale and delivery identity histories.
repository_evidence.operating_license_boundary: Campaign179 freezes statutory operating rights and concessions. A presale permit is project-specific permission to market defined units, not the issuer's general operating license; permit scope, project phase, inventory and revocation must remain separate.
repository_evidence.accounting_boundary: Inventory, contract liabilities, revenue recognition, impairment, interest capitalization or cash collections cannot be renamed as project execution quality without parcel, project, phase, unit, contract, permit and delivery histories.
repository_evidence.sector_boundary: Point-in-time real-estate developer scope, listed security mapping, mixed-business issuers and structural not-applicability must be frozen before any cross-section; non-developers cannot be filled with zero or mixed into a project-state rank.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current land bank, current project list or latest contracted-sales table cannot be projected backward without parcel acquisition, rights and zoning, project phase, permit, launch, contract, cancellation, collection, completion, delivery, delay, disposal, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact exchange filing, annual or interim project schedule, presale permit, land registry or auction record, housing authority record or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable issuer, parcel, project, phase, permit, contract-batch, document and observation identifiers

acquisition, rights grant, zoning, planning, construction start, presale permit, sales launch, contract signing, cancellation, collection, completion, inspection, delivery, delay, remediation, disposal, correction, first-public and supersession timestamps with trading-session availability
issuer, listed security, parent, subsidiary, project company, joint venture, developer, land-right holder, contractor, purchaser group and government authority mapping without current-state leakage

point-in-time sector and business-scope taxonomy separating property development, investment property, construction contractor, property management, industrial park, infrastructure concession and non-property business with structural not-applicability
parcel, land certificate, project, phase, building, batch, unit, city, district, use, tenure, gross floor area, saleable area and status identity with split, merge, rename and transfer history

land acquisition method, consideration, premium, rights area, planned area, zoning, idle-land status, development deadline, transfer restriction, mortgage, withdrawal, forfeiture and disposal semantics

planning, construction, presale and completion permits, approved and saleable inventory, launch, subscribed, contracted, cancelled and remaining units or area with permit scope and revocation semantics
contracted sales, cancellations, contracted average price, cash collections, escrowed funds, receivables, mortgage approval and refund semantics with gross and attributable presentation
presold obligation, scheduled and actual completion, inspection, handover, customer acceptance, certificate, delay, compensation, quality remediation and government delivery-support semantics
project investment, construction cost, capitalized interest, project financing, guarantees, regulatory escrow, restricted cash, impairment, partner funding and off-balance-sheet obligation semantics

unit, currency, area basis, gross and attributable interest, consolidated scope, double-counting, restatement and missing, undisclosed, not-applicable, not-launched, sold-out, cancelled, delayed and true-zero semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full eligible-developer denominator, issuer, parcel, project, phase and permit identifier history, delisting and merger coverage, parser and pagination, identity, timing, sector, rights, sales, collection, delivery, failure and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: land_acquisition_land_bank_rights_zoning_idle_and_disposal_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer land and project-pipeline state linking parcels and projects to acquisition, rights, zoning, planned area, development deadlines, idle status, encumbrance, withdrawal, forfeiture and disposal.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time history freezes parcel, project and holder identity, acquisition and rights terms, zoning and planned area, deadlines, encumbrance, idle-land decisions, transfer or disposal, corrections and first-public timing across 2019-2023.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: project_approval_construction_presale_permit_and_sales_launch_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known project readiness state covering planning and construction approval, physical start and progress, presale permit scope, approved saleable inventory, launch, suspension, permit amendment and revocation.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete project and phase history connecting approvals, construction evidence, permit scope and effective dates, launch inventory, suspension or revocation, corrections and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: contracted_sales_cancellation_collection_sell_through_and_backlog_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known project sales state covering subscribed and contracted units or area and value, cancellations, average price, collections, refunds, escrow, mortgage progress, remaining inventory and presold backlog.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time source preserves project and permit identity, gross and attributable scope, signed and cancelled contracts, collections and refunds, escrow, mortgage status, remaining inventory, revisions, corrections and full failed-sale coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: project_completion_delivery_acceptance_delay_compensation_and_remediation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known project fulfillment state linking presold obligations to scheduled and actual completion, inspection, handover, customer acceptance, certificate issuance, delay, compensation, quality remediation and government support.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source connects each presold project phase and delivery batch to promised and actual dates, inspection and acceptance, certificates, delays, compensation, remediation, corrections and complete first-public history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: inventory_contract_liability_revenue_kpi_permit_capex_price_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing inventory, contract liability, recognized revenue, generic operating KPI, statutory permit, capital expenditure, product price or security-price state relabelled as project pipeline, sales quality or delivery fulfillment.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Aggregate accounting or adjacent-domain states do not identify parcels, projects, permits, valid contracts, cancellations, collections, delivery obligations, delays, remediation or project-level revision chains.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: land_project_sales_delivery_direction_unit_city_denominator_term_window_or_sector_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of land reserves, acquired area, construction progress, permitted inventory, contracted sales, collections, cancellations, delivery, delays, city tier, ownership share, area or value units and event window.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing more or less land, high or low sales or delivery, successful projects only, city tier, project type, gross versus attributable scope, area versus value, denominator, lag or window before source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_land_pipeline_presale_sales_collection_delivery_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer property-project lifecycle score across land and pipeline, permits and construction, contracted sales and collections, and delivery fulfillment or remediation.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or choosing normalization, ranks, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before sector scope and every base source contract are complete.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct land, project-permit, contracted-sales and delivery lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; accounting or adjacent-domain relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.
